request: Give 14 heavy-lifting baseline skills a written character — soul, motivation, mantra. A shared doctrine file is the source of truth; a build step stamps the block into each SKILL.md; audit-baseline fails on a missing or incomplete block. Anti-slack rule: a backlog entry with source: assistant-deferral must carry a deferred: dependency|risk|cost|human-directed tag, and an untagged entry is a checker BLOCKER, enforced on touch. Claude drafts the words; the human approves them at gate A. Additionally, make code-structure's existing comment rule binding via its oracle, so comments appear only where a why-comment is warranted.
novelty_evidence: grep for mantra / character blocks across .claude/skills, docs/init and src returns zero hits, and no stage of scripts/build-template.sh writes a block into SKILL.md — the doctrine surface has no precedent. The deferred: dependency|risk|cost|human-directed tag is precedented at .claude/skills/spec-traceability-review/oracle.mjs and CLAUDE.md VI.4 for spec AC rows, but no oracle applies it to backlog entries.
track_reason: intake-full over the leaner spec-entry because the change edits audit-baseline, which project.json → test.cmd names as the binding verdict command, and rewrites 12 baseline-owned SKILL.md files whose manifest hashes the audit reconciles. Chosen over epic because project.json → release.completeness_gate.half_wired_blocks_release is true and consumer_upgrade_cadence is rare: epic children commit separately, so every intermediate landing would ship doctrine text without its audit, or an audit without its oracle.

decisions.location: shared doctrine file is the source of truth; a build step writes the block into each SKILL.md
decisions.force: binding — audit-baseline fails on a missing or incomplete block
decisions.scope: fourteen SKILL.md files: brainstorm, intake, spec, spec-shippability-review, spec-traceability-review, spec-diagram-review, spec-rollout-enforceability-review, scenario, implement, code-structure, tdd, simplify, integrate, security
decisions.anti_slack: a backlog entry with source: assistant-deferral must carry deferred: dependency|risk|cost|human-directed; untagged is a checker BLOCKER
decisions.backfill: enforce on touch — the oracle applies to any entry a workflow writes or reopens; untouched entries stay untagged
decisions.authorship: Claude drafts all 12 character sets; the human approves or edits them at gate A
decisions.scope_corrections: Scout 2026-08-14 found two approved ACs unbuildable. D-4: audit derives its target set from the doctrine file, not owner: — spec-shippability-review is dev-only by design and annotating it would ship it plus force a 56->62 count cascade needing a seed.md amendment first. D-5: the 2026-08-09 D-6 rejection of a what-comment detector is upheld; only an aggregate ratio lands, advisory. D-6: code-structure SOP inverts the default — comment-free first draft, review-phase request as the sanctioned trigger.
decisions.comment_rule: Fourth deliverable added: code-structure SOP directs a comment-free first draft; a comment enters via a review-phase request. Enforcement by ordering, not by oracle — which is why it succeeds where the 2026-08-09 D-6 correctly judged an oracle would fail.
